description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: There is no known interaction between Pioneer factor OCT3/4 and major chromatin remodeling factors.
Claim 2: Mitochondria play a major role in apoptosis.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Mitochondria play a major role in apoptosis.
rationale: Additionally, they participate in intermediary metabolism, calcium signaling, and apoptosis.

seeds.text: There is no known interaction between Pioneer factor OCT3/4 and major chromatin remodeling factors.
rationale: Subsequent purification of Oct4 partners Sall4, Tcfcp2l1, Dax1, and Esrrb resulted in an Oct4 interactome of 166 proteins, including transcription factors and chromatin-modifying complexes with documented roles in self-renewal, but also many factors not previously associated with the ESC network.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Mitochondria play a major role in apoptosis.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: There is no known interaction between Pioneer factor OCT3/4 and major chromatin remodeling factors.

paper_b_result.description: Cites the key result from Paper B (166)

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called supported, but Paper B contradicts it

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but Paper A supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results support the claim that there is no known interaction between Pioneer factor OCT3/4 and major chromatin remodeling factors.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper B supports Claim 1 (There is no known interaction between Pioneer factor OCT3/4 and major chromatin remodeling factors.)
key_findings.description: Flips the contradicted claim to supported

sources.value: Paper A is the evidence for Claim 1 and Paper B is the evidence for Claim 2.
sources.description: Swaps which paper backs which claim

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: SUPPORTED. Claim 2: SUPPORTED.
conclusions.description: Both claims supported, erasing the contradiction
